_comment: Edge functions deployed with NO source in this repo. They cannot be read, reviewed, fixed or redeployed — only invoked or deleted. The list may only SHRINK: a new orphan fails the build. Each entry needs a reason and a way out. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-deployed-functions.mjs --write-baseline

tmp-b2b-search-probe.reason: Diagnostic from #370 (b2b search model/effort measurement). Already retired IN PLACE to a 4-line 410 stub whose own first comment reads 'RETIRED diagnostic (issue #370) ... Safe to DELETE'; the findings live on #370 and in _shared/tools/b2b-tools.ts. Nothing invokes it and it answers 410 to everything that tries.
tmp-b2b-search-probe.wayOut: supabase functions delete tmp-b2b-search-probe --project-ref "$PROJECT_REF" — needs a management token, which is why it is recorded here rather than removed in the commit that added this file.

tmp-replicate-fingerprint.reason: One-shot diagnostic from 2026-08-30 that compared which Replicate credential the edge runtime resolves against the one on the MIVAA droplet. It answered its question (same token, fingerprint 8fecbec9, account `basilakis`) and was retired IN PLACE the same day: version 2 is an 11-line stub that answers 410 to everything, holds no secret, and whose own first comment reads 'RETIRED 2026-08-30 ... DELETE IT'. Recorded rather than deleted for the same reason as the entry above — see wayOut. It made every deploy report failure from 08:52 on 2026-08-30 while the deploy step itself kept succeeding, which also skipped `mark-deployed-functions` and left the `deployed/functions` marker stale, so each push redeployed all 134 functions instead of the changed ones.
tmp-replicate-fingerprint.wayOut: supabase functions delete tmp-replicate-fingerprint --project-ref "$PROJECT_REF", or Supabase dashboard -> Edge Functions -> tmp-replicate-fingerprint -> Delete. Needs a management token: the Supabase MCP surface can deploy a function but not delete one, and no SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN or supabase CLI is available in the environment this was recorded from.
